g.text: Title: Inverter power base - removable STM32G431 controller

g.desc: Title: Inverter power base - removable STM32G431 controller

g.text: HARDWARE REVIEW DRAFT - NOT RELEASED FOR PCB

g.desc: HARDWARE REVIEW DRAFT - NOT RELEASED FOR PCB

g.text: INVERTER | non-isolated laboratory draft | 12-60 V bus | separate 12-24 V auxiliary

g.desc: INVERTER | non-isolated laboratory draft | 12-60 V bus | separate 12-24 V auxiliary

g.text: POWER BASE / REMOVABLE MCU SUB-BOARD / REV D REVIEW

g.desc: POWER BASE / REMOVABLE MCU SUB-BOARD / REV D REVIEW

g.text: Common-ground plug-in controller. Power base retains one three-phase bridge, brake, analogue sensing and all hardware protection.

g.desc: Common-ground plug-in controller. Power base retains one three-phase bridge, brake, analogue sensing and all hardware protection.

g.text: 12-60 V bus / DC input <=10 A / phase 10 Arms design target / separate 12-24 V auxiliary.

g.desc: 12-60 V bus / DC input <=10 A / phase 10 Arms design target / separate 12-24 V auxiliary.

g.text: MCU / SWD / TTL / CAN / encoder / SPI live on the removable controller board. No shared NRST net.

g.desc: MCU / SWD / TTL / CAN / encoder / SPI live on the removable controller board. No shared NRST net.

g.text: BASE_LOGIC_OK is local base-supply reset permission, not the controller NRST.

g.desc: BASE_LOGIC_OK is local base-supply reset permission, not the controller NRST.

g.text: CTRL_READY LOW or missing controller blocks ENABLE; BASE_READY separately reports local logic plus driver supply.

g.desc: CTRL_READY LOW or missing controller blocks ENABLE; BASE_READY separately reports local logic plus driver supply.

g.text: This schematic supersedes the archived integrated Rev C design; the old PCB is not valid for Rev D.
